name: m5-fused-erasure-spike
description: Spike, [retronym/scala#254](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/254) at `79987409fc` (`claude/eraser-single-visit`: fused, single-visit retyper): erasure's retype without a `Typer` (`-Ynew-erasure`), and the same with `preErase` fused into its traversal (`-Yfused-erasure`). One build, flags toggled per variant, alternating by iteration within each fork; `aa` is `base` again. Whole compile of the scala corpus (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`). m5-pro, patched JDK 26, 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation, release optimizer settings. All three paths emit identical classfiles for library, reflect and compiler.

variantDescriptions.fused: `-Yfused-erasure`: one traversal, `preErase` per node on entry
